conditional.interpretation: Practical replication screen for current-branch D111−D000; not a significance test, policy gate or permission to promote a counterfactual hybrid.

recurrent.interpretation: Practical replication screen for current-branch D111−D000; not a significance test, policy gate or permission to promote a counterfactual hybrid.

inference.unit: Independent seed; two assessments averaged before bootstrap
inference.repair_sign: 111 minus the cell that restores one component to old; positive Brier means restoration lowers error.
inference.environment_sign: Return minus current law with branch-specific evolving feedback, initially identical history.
inference.absolute_stats: The differences array for selector and zero metrics contains absolute seed values.
inference.oracle: Validation-full-Brier-selected single candidate; all other oracle outcomes use that same candidate.
inference.rank_agreement: Tied-average Spearman; average assessments then seeds. A constant comparison makes its seed and cohort rank mean undefined; no assessment is dropped and primary metrics are unaffected.
inference.limits: Counterfactual state substitutions, not natural on-policy contributions, unique blame shares or a retention policy.
